Cover: Marcy Murray, Name of Office 'Recorder', Republican, Heber UT; Primary Report box checked; signed 6/14/2024; both acknowledgement lines initialled. Same nil-mark pattern as Crittenden and handled identically: the first body row of BOTH tables is filled with slashed-Ø in every one of its four cells (date, name/payee, amount, in-kind/purpose). Those are nil marks, not entries — no rows emitted, because a Ø in a name column is not a contributor. The TOTAL cells' slashed zeros do read as 0.00 and both sides reconcile exactly. ONE PLACEMENT ODDITY worth recording: on both tables the TOTAL figure is written in the FOURTH column (In-Kind / Purpose) rather than in the Amount column, straddling the cell boundary — read positionally it sits outside the Amount column, but it is unambiguously the total for the row labelled TOTAL:, and it is a zero either way, so nothing turns on it.
